passive.name: Whispers of Wind and Flower
passive.text: Within 8s after the character's Elemental Skill hits an opponent or the character triggers an Elemental Reaction, their ATK and Elemental Mastery will be increased by **12/15/18/21/24%** and **48/60/72/84/96** respectively.

passive.name: Desert Pavilion
passive.text: The following effect will trigger every 10s: The equipping character will gain **24/30/36/42/48%** of their Elemental Mastery as bonus ATK for 12s, with nearby party members gaining 30% of this buff for the same duration. Multiple instances of this weapon can allow this buff to stack. This effect will still trigger even if the character is not on the field.

passive.name: Bane of Storm and Tide
passive.text: Increases DMG against opponents affected by Hydro or Electro by **20/24/28/32/36%**.

passive.name: Forest Sanctuary
passive.text: After triggering Burning, Quicken, Aggravate, Spread, Bloom, Lunar-Bloom, Hyperbloom, or Burgeon, a Leaf of Consciousness will be created around the character for a maximum of 10s. When picked up, the Leaf will grant the character **60/75/90/105/120** Elemental Mastery for 12s. Only 1 Leaf can be generated this way every 20s. This effect can still be triggered if the character is not on the field. The Leaf of Consciousness' effect cannot stack.

substatLine: Energy Recharge > Elemental Mastery > CRIT Rate > CRIT DMG > ATK%
skillPriority: Elemental Burst > Normal Attack > Elemental Skill

entries.name: Schematic Setup
entries.text:
**Normal Attack**
Uses Mehrak to perform up to 4 consecutive attacks.

**Charged Attack**
Drains Stamina over time to perform continuous slashes.
At the end of the sequence, performs a more powerful slash.

**Plunging Attack**
Plunges from mid-air to strike the ground, damaging opponents along the path and dealing AoE DMG upon impact.

entries.name: Artistic Ingenuity
entries.text:
Uses Mehrak's mapping ability for offensive purposes, initiating a radial scan that deals **AoE Dendro DMG**. It will also scan all Dendro Cores in its AoE and cause them to immediately burst.

Mehrak was created through the modification of ancient technology and may have some other functions apart from mapping work...

entries.name: Painted Dome
entries.text:
Completely unleashes Mehrak's energy and creates a cubic scanned space, dealing **AoE Dendro DMG** to all opponents within it, causing all Dendro Cores in its AoE to immediately burst, and granting Kaveh the following enhanced combat abilities for a specific duration:
· Increases Kaveh's Normal, Charged, and Plunging Attack AoE, and converts his attack DMG to **Dendro DMG** that cannot be overridden.
· All Dendro Cores created by all your own party members through Bloom and Lunar-Bloom reactions will deal additional DMG when they burst.
· Increases Kaveh's resistance to interruption.
These effects will be canceled once Kaveh leaves the field.

"Every building style includes the architect's unique worldview, and from this angle, one can say that the buildings themselves are coalescences of human memories."

entries.name: An Architect's Undertaking
entries.text: When DMG dealt by a Dendro Core (including DMG from Burgeon and Hyperbloom) hits Kaveh, Kaveh will regain HP equal to 300% of his Elemental Mastery. This effect can be triggered once every 0.5s.

entries.name: A Craftsman's Curious Conceptions
entries.text:
During **Painted Dome**, after Kaveh's Normal, Charged, or Plunging Attacks hit opponents, his Elemental Mastery will increase by 25. This effect can be triggered once every 0.1s. Max 4 stacks.
This effect will be canceled when Painted Dome's effects end.

entries.name: The Art of Budgeting
entries.text: When Kaveh crafts Landscape, Building, and Courtyard-type Furnishings, he has a 100% chance to refund a portion of the materials used.

entries.name: Sublime Salutations
entries.text: Within 3s after using **Artistic Ingenuity**, Kaveh's **Dendro RES** and Incoming Healing Bonus will be increased by 50% and 25% respectively.

entries.name: Grace of Royal Roads
entries.text: Kaveh's Normal Attack SPD increases by 15% during **Painted Dome**.

entries.name: Profferings of Dur Untash
entries.text:
Increases the Level of **Painted Dome** by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

entries.name: Feast of Apadana
entries.text: Dendro Cores created from Bloom and Lunar-Bloom reactions Kaveh triggers will deal 60% more DMG when they burst.

entries.name: Treasures of Bonkhanak
entries.text:
Increases the Level of **Artistic Ingenuity** by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

entries.name: Pairidaeza's Dreams
entries.text: When Kaveh's Normal, Charged, or Plunging Attacks hit opponents during **Painted Dome**, they will unleash Pairidaeza's Light upon the opponent's position, dealing 61.8% of Kaveh's ATK as **AoE Dendro DMG** and causing all Dendro Cores within that AoE to burst. This effect can be triggered once every 3s.
